lessons.story:
STUDENT PRINTING DESK: Black-and-white printing costs one dollar for each printed side. Color printing costs five dollars per side. A sheet printed on both sides contains two printed sides, so double-sided printing saves paper but does not change the charge per printed side.

Send your file before two for pickup after three on the same school day. Files received after two are ready the following school day. Include your name, class, number of copies, and whether you want color. Staff will print in black and white unless color is requested.

The desk can staple documents of up to twenty sheets at no extra cost. Larger documents are returned unstapled. Check the page order in your file before sending it; the desk does not rearrange sections or remove blank pages automatically.

If you notice a printing error caused by the desk, bring the entire document back within two school days. If the original file contains the mistake, a corrected reprint is charged as a new job.
lessons.title: Printing Without Surprises
